_comment: Single source of truth for every upstream ref this repo indexes or mirrors.
FSM-App has THREE Frappe/ERPNext pins and they are not the same number - see the table in
FSM-App/CLAUDE.md § Version pins. `source` below is the PRODUCTION/CI pin, because that is
what shipped code runs against and therefore what a claim about 'the platform' must mean.
Do NOT point `source` at scripts/devcontainer-init.sh. That holds the devcontainer pin
(v16.20.0), which FSM-App's CLAUDE.md calls out as behind the other two - a known
divergence, not a target. Indexing it would make this repo answer confidently about a
platform production is not on, which is the exact failure it exists to prevent.
Note frappe/erpnext:vX.Y.Z is tagged with the ERPNext version, so the Frappe version inside
the production image differs from the image tag by design. These are per-repo tags, so the
pairing is explicit here and needs no inference.

source._comment: Production + CI. Enforced by ARG FRAPPE_VERSION in infrastructure/production/Dockerfile and FRAPPE_BRANCH/ERPNEXT_BRANCH in .github/workflows/ci.yml.

devcontainer._comment: What local dev runs, from FSM-App/scripts/devcontainer-init.sh. Behind production on purpose. index/drift.md reports what differs, so a 'works on my machine' gap is visible instead of surprising.

vendor._comment: Doc sets that genuinely live in git, synced verbatim. Resolved SHAs land in vendor/_manifest.json.

_comment: docs.frappe.io is a Frappe Wiki site - the content is in that site's database, not a repo.
frappe/frappe_docs was archived in Dec 2021. So these subtrees are crawled, not cloned.
Note there is no v16 tree upstream: framework docs stop at v15, ERPNext has no versioned
current tree at all. For anything v16-specific the index/ layer is the only real answer.
